# Surveys & Position Papers

> Surveys, position papers and essays that frame embodied agents and their harnesses.  
> Layer: meta · 84 entries · [overview](../README.md#survey) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- ⚪ [**World-Action Models survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16074 "World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey") · 2026-09 — Robotics-oriented review of world-action models that couple future-world prediction with action generation: taxonomy over representations, architectures, training and data; applications in manipulation, navigation and driving; and evaluation protocols. [project](https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Awesome-World-Action-Models/)
- ⚪ [**World Models for Embodied Intelligence: Plausible, Controllable, Actionable**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.16697 "World Models for Embodied Intelligence: From Plausible to Controllable to Actionable") · 2026-09 — Surveys embodied world models by which predictive capabilities improve behavior (plausible, controllable, actionable) across manipulation, navigation, locomotion and driving, and argues evaluation should move from visual plausibility to closed-loop impact. [project](https://3dagentworld.github.io/EmbodiedWM/)
- ⚪ [**Toward Unified Robot Learning**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03927 "Toward Unified Robot Learning: Bridging Representation, Vision-Language-Action, and World Models") · 2026-09 — Organizes robot learning along representation learning (understanding), VLAs (acting) and world models (reasoning), and argues that robustness requires integrating the three.
- ⚪ [**Robot-use agents**](https://web.mit.edu/phillipi/www/writing/robot-use-agents.html) · 2026-09 · MIT (Phillip Isola) — Perspective arguing that general-purpose LLM agents can now use robots as tools through sensor and actuator APIs, with discussion of deployment, latency and reliability limits.
- 🟢 [**No Free Checker**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09250 "No Free Checker: A Survey of Verifiers for Robot Policies") · 2026-09 — Survey of about 150 robot-policy verifiers (success detectors, reward models, runtime monitors, safety filters, temporal-logic specs) compared by availability and credibility, finding credibility falls as verdicts get cheaper and denser. _Note: Most directly relevant survey for the verification category._ [code](https://github.com/ZJUSCL/Awesome-Robot-Verifier)
- ⚪ [**Generative Physical AI review**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18111 "A Comprehensive Review of Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence") · 2026-09 — Survey of generative physical AI organized into robot foundation models, VLAs, large behaviour models, diffusion policies and world foundation models, covering how they complement each other and where they are applied.
- 🟢 [**Awesome Multimodal Embodied Agents**](https://showlab.github.io/Awesome-Multimodal-Embodied-Agent/ "Awesome Multimodal Embodied Agents: From Computer-Use to Robot-Use") · 2026-09 · Show Lab, National University of Singapore — Survey and curated list that treats computer-use and robot-use agents in one capability framework (Perceive, Anticipate, Plan, Act, Verify) and maps the agent-plus-robot landscape. _Note: No arXiv version found; the README links a figshare DOI._ [code](https://github.com/showlab/Awesome-Multimodal-Embodied-Agent)
- ⚪ [**Security of FM-powered embodied agents**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16843 "Security of Foundation-Model-Powered Embodied Agents: Attack Surfaces, Attacks, Defenses, and Evaluation") · 2026-08 — Trust-boundary survey locating where attacks enter the embodied control loop: five layers and twelve surfaces incl. context/memory, world state, action interfaces, middleware and multi-agent links (58 attack, 61 defense records).
- ⚪ [**Functional roles of language in embodied agents**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03099 "What Language Does and What the Evidence Supports: A Functional Role Taxonomy and Evidence Audit of Language Grounding in Embodied Agents") · 2026-08 — Defines five roles for language in embodied agents (specification, representation, action orchestration, grounding regulation, execution coupling) and audits whether reported evidence supports each claimed role.
- ⚪ [**Security of World-Model-Based Embodied AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28226 "Security of World-Model-Based Embodied AI: A Lifecycle of Threats, Defenses, and Evaluation") · 2026-07 — Traces attacks on world-model-based embodied agents across the lifecycle, from data and representation learning through state grounding and imagination to execution and memory/tool-based adaptation.
- ⚪ [**Harness Engineering source-code study**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00006 "Harness Engineering: Anatomy, Architecture, and Evolution of Coding Agents -- A Source-Code Study of Eleven Systems") · 2026-07 — Source-code anatomy of eleven production coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenHands, etc.) mapping seven canonical subsystems and 29 recurring design patterns, the reference point for the embodied analogy. _Note: Not embodied. arXiv v1 dated Jul 2026 although the ID is 2609._
- 🟡 [**Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24744 "Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation: A Survey") · 2026-07 — Organizes embodied training data into a pyramid (real-robot, UMI-style, egocentric/exocentric human, simulation, web vision-language) and analyzes the data recipes of embodied brain models, VLAs and world-action models. [code](https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-embodied-data-pyramid) · [project](https://jasper-aaa.github.io/embodied-data-pyramid/)
- ⚪ [**SoK: Security and Privacy of FM-Powered Robots**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16788 "SoK: Security and Privacy of Foundation-Model-Powered Robots") · 2026-06 · Nanyang Technological University / Wuhan University — Systematizes 96 papers on security and privacy of FM-powered robots with a four-layer boundary framework (foundation model, embodied system, supporting ecosystem, governance) and a threat/mitigation taxonomy.
- ⚪ [**Safe Embodied AI for Long-horizon Tasks**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05660 "Safe Embodied AI for Long-horizon Tasks: A Cross-layer Analysis of Robotic Manipulation") · 2026-06 — Organizes safety work for long-horizon manipulation by intervention point (planning-time, policy-time, execution-time), covering misgrounding, error propagation, execution drift and contact risk.
- ⚪ [**Robot middleware as harness**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09416 "Harness Engineering for Physical AI: Robot Middleware Is the Harness Layer") · 2026-06 — Position paper arguing that robot middleware should be the Physical-AI harness, mediating learned policies at the control, computing and communication layers at once rather than only at tool-call boundaries.
- 🟡 [**Agent System and Harness Design survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20683 "From Question Answering to Task Completion: A Survey on Agent System and Harness Design") · 2026-06 · CityU Hong Kong / University of Sydney / Peking University — Model-harness view of LLM agents that splits the execution harness into observation, context, control, action, state and verification, and maps task properties to harness configurations and evaluation practice. _Note: Mostly software agents; embodied settings discussed briefly._ [code](https://github.com/ggjy/Awesome-Agent-Engineering)
- ⚪ [**A Tutorial on World Models and Physical AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.12783) · 2026-06 — Tutorial contrasting explicit world models (structured dynamics for rollout-based planning) with implicit ones (predictive representations) and their role in robotics and autonomous driving.
- ⚪ [**3D Scene Graphs: Open Challenges**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19383 "3D Scene Graphs: Open Challenges and Future Directions") · 2026-06 — Invited Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems article that surveys 3D scene graph formulations, construction pipelines and evaluation across robotics and vision, and lays out open challenges.
- ⚪ [**World Action Models survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12090 "World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI") · 2026-05 — Defines World Action Models, embodied foundation models that jointly predict future states and actions, and organizes them into cascaded vs joint designs with analysis of data sources and evaluation.
- 🟡 [**Code as Agent Harness**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18747) · 2026-05 · UIUC / Meta / Stanford — Survey framing code as the substrate of agent harnesses (interfaces for reasoning and action; planning, memory and tool-use mechanisms; multi-agent coordination), covering embodied code-as-policy agents alongside coding agents. [code](https://github.com/YennNing/Awesome-Code-as-Agent-Harness-Papers) · [project](https://code-as-harness.github.io/code-as-harness-webpage/)
- ⚪ [**World Model for Robot Learning survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00080 "World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey") · 2026-04 — Reviews world models from a robot-learning perspective: coupling with policies, learned simulators for RL and evaluation, the progression of robotic video world models, links to navigation and driving, and datasets and benchmarks.
- ⚪ [**VLA Safety Survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23775 "Vision-Language-Action Safety: Threats, Challenges, Evaluations, and Mechanisms") · 2026-04 — Survey organising VLA safety by attack and defence timing (training vs. inference), covering poisoning and backdoors, adversarial patches, jailbreaks, runtime defences, benchmarks and deployment domains.
- ⚪ [**VLA datasets, benchmarks and data engines survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23001 "Vision-Language-Action in Robotics: A Survey of Datasets, Benchmarks, and Data Engines") · 2026-04 — Data-centric survey of VLA research organized around datasets, benchmarks and data engines, analyzing benchmark task complexity and environment structure and identifying gaps in compositional-generalization and long-horizon evaluation. _Note: Accepted to TMLR (per arXiv comment)._
- ⚪ [**Foundation Models in Robotics review (2026)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15395 "Foundation Models in Robotics: A Comprehensive Review of Methods, Models, Datasets, Challenges and Future Research Directions") · 2026-04 — Systematic review tracing five phases of foundation models in robotics and classifying work by FM type (LLM, VFM, VLM, VLA), architecture, learning paradigm, task and application, with a dataset report.
- ⚪ [**Externalization in LLM Agents**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08224 "Externalization in LLM Agents: A Unified Review of Memory, Skills, Protocols and Harness Engineering") · 2026-04 · Shanghai Jiao Tong University et al. — Argues agent capability is increasingly externalized into memory, reusable skills and interaction protocols, with harness engineering as the layer that coordinates them into governed execution (weights to context to harness). _Note: Software-agent focus; provides the harness vocabulary reused for embodiment._
- 🟢 [**Agent Harness for LLM Agents (survey + list)**](https://github.com/Gloriaameng/Awesome-Agent-Harness "Agent Harness for Large Language Model Agents: A Survey") · 2026-04 — Survey repository formalizing the agent execution harness as a six-component tuple and reviewing 110+ papers, blogs and reports across 23 systems on tool registries, context management, state and execution loops. _Note: Survey is a preprints.org preprint (DOI 10.20944/preprints202604.0428); that site blocked automated fetches. Not embodied._
- ⚪ [**Will World Models Allow Robots to Think?**](https://itcanthink.substack.com/p/will-world-models-allow-robots-to) · 2026-03 · Chris Paxton (essay) — Essay grouping robot world models into action-conditioned, video-plus-inverse-dynamics and joint world-action approaches, arguing that better video models, data and architectures now make them compelling for robotics.
- 🟡 [**Safety in Embodied AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02900 "Safety in Embodied AI: A Survey of Risks, Attacks, and Defenses") · 2026-03 — 500+-paper survey of attacks and defenses across perception, cognition, planning, action, interaction and agentic layers of embodied systems, incl. adversarial, backdoor, jailbreak and hardware attacks. _Note: arXiv v1 dated Mar 2026 although the ID is 2605._ [code](https://github.com/x-zheng16/Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety) · [project](https://x-zheng16.github.io/Awesome-Embodied-AI-Safety/)
- ⚪ [**Robotic Foundation Models for Industrial Control**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06749 "Robotic Foundation Models for Industrial Control: A Comprehensive Survey and Readiness Assessment Framework") · 2026-03 — Turns eleven industrial deployment implications into a 149-criterion readiness framework and evaluates 324 manipulation-capable robotic foundation models against it.
- 🟢 [**awesome-harness-engineering**](https://github.com/ai-boost/awesome-harness-engineering) · 2026-03 — Awesome list for AI-agent harness engineering: tools, patterns, evals, memory, MCP, permissions, observability and orchestration; the software-agent reference for embodied harness design.
- 🟢 [**Awesome Harness Engineering (walkinglabs)**](https://github.com/walkinglabs/awesome-harness-engineering) · 2026-03 — Curated articles, playbooks, benchmarks, specs and projects on harness engineering, the practice of shaping the environment around AI agents (context, evaluation, observability, orchestration, safe autonomy). _Note: Software agents; not embodied._
- ⚪ [**Self-evolving Embodied AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04411) · 2026-02 — Defines self-evolving embodied AI (memory self-updating, task self-switching, environment self-prediction, embodiment self-adaptation, model self-evolution) and reviews work realizing each component.
- ⚪ [**Harness engineering (OpenAI)**](https://openai.com/index/harness-engineering/ "Harness engineering: leveraging Codex in an agent-first world") · 2026-02 · OpenAI — Report on shipping a product whose code was written entirely by Codex agents, recasting engineering as harness design: repository legibility, context maps, enforced invariants and feedback loops. _Note: Page blocks automated fetches (403); URL/title confirmed via search index, date (2026-02-11) from a secondary summary. Not embodied._
- 🟢 [**Awesome Physical AI**](https://github.com/keon/awesome-physical-ai) · 2026-01 — Curated list of papers and resources on Physical AI, focusing on VLA models, world models, embodied AI and robotic foundation models.

**2025**

- ⚪ [**Embodied Robot Manipulation in the Era of Foundation Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22983 "Embodied Robot Manipulation in the Era of Foundation Models: Planning and Learning Perspectives") · 2025-12 — Condensed companion to the unified manipulation survey, organizing methods into high-level planning (language, code, affordances, geometry, 3D) and low-level learned action models.
- ⚪ [**Anatomy of VLA Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11362 "An Anatomy of Vision-Language-Action Models: From Modules to Milestones and Challenges") · 2025-12 — Guide that moves from VLA modules through milestones to five challenge areas: representation, execution, generalization, safety, and datasets/evaluation. [project](https://suyuz1.github.io/VLA-Survey-Anatomy/)
- ⚪ [**Project Fetch**](https://www.anthropic.com/research/project-fetch-robot-dog "Project Fetch: Can Claude train a robot dog?") · 2025-11 · Anthropic — Uplift study in which two teams of non-roboticist staff, one with Claude and one without, programmed quadrupeds to fetch a beach ball; the Claude-assisted team completed more tasks in about half the time. _Note: Claude assisted humans rather than acting autonomously; see project-fetch-phase-two._
- ⚪ [**Effective harnesses for long-running agents**](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents) · 2025-11 · Anthropic — Engineering post on a two-part harness (initializer agent plus incremental coding agent) that carries state across context windows with feature lists, progress files, git history and end-to-end tests. _Note: Coding-agent source of the harness framing; not embodied._
- 🟡 [**World models for embodied AI survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.16732 "A Comprehensive Survey on World Models for Embodied AI") · 2025-10 — Three-axis taxonomy of embodied world models (decision-coupled vs general-purpose, temporal modeling, spatial representation) with datasets, metrics and quantitative comparisons across robotics, driving and video. [code](https://github.com/Li-Zn-H/AwesomeWorldModels)
- ⚪ [**VLA review towards real-world applications**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07077 "Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotics: A Review Towards Real-World Applications") · 2025-10 · University of Tokyo et al. — Full-stack VLA review: architectures, modality processing and learning paradigms together with robot platforms, data-collection strategies, datasets, augmentation and evaluation benchmarks. [project](https://vla-survey.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**Unified robot manipulation survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10903 "Towards a Unified Understanding of Robot Manipulation: A Comprehensive Survey") · 2025-10 — Manipulation survey that widens high-level planning to language, code, motion, affordance and 3D representations, adds a taxonomy of learned low-level control, and catalogs data and generalization bottlenecks. [code](https://github.com/BaiShuanghao/Awesome-Robotics-Manipulation)
- ⚪ [**Robot Learning: A Tutorial**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.12403) · 2025-10 · Hugging Face — Tutorial from RL and behavior cloning to generalist language-conditioned, cross-embodiment policies, with runnable examples implemented in LeRobot.
- ⚪ [**Efficient VLA survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.24795 "A Survey on Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models") · 2025-10 · Tongji University et al. — Taxonomy of VLA efficiency across the model-training-data pipeline: efficient model design (architectures, compression), efficient training, and efficient data collection. Accepted to IEEE TPAMI. [project](https://evla-survey.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**A Step Toward World Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02097 "A Step Toward World Models: A Survey on Robotic Manipulation") · 2025-10 — Reviews manipulation methods that exhibit core world-model capabilities (state encoding, dynamics, prediction, planning) rather than only methods explicitly labeled as world models.
- ⚪ [**Why Today's Humanoids Won't Learn Dexterity**](https://rodneybrooks.com/why-todays-humanoids-wont-learn-dexterity/) · 2025-09 · Rodney Brooks (essay) — Essay arguing humanoids will not learn dexterity from visual demonstration data alone without rich touch sensing, noting that learning successes in speech and vision relied on engineered data front-ends.
- ⚪ [**Pure VLA survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19012 "Pure Vision Language Action (VLA) Models: A Comprehensive Survey") · 2025-09 — Taxonomy of VLA methods into autoregression-, diffusion- and reinforcement-based, hybrid and specialized approaches, plus datasets, benchmarks and simulation platforms.
- ⚪ [**Embodied AI: From LLMs to World Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.20021) · 2025-09 — Reviews embodied AI driven by (M)LLMs for semantic reasoning and task decomposition and by world models for physically consistent prediction, and argues for joint MLLM-world-model architectures. IEEE CASM.
- ⚪ [**Towards Embodied Agentic AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.05294 "Towards Embodied Agentic AI: Review and Classification of LLM- and VLM-Driven Robot Autonomy and Interaction") · 2025-08 — Reviews agentic robot architectures in which LLM/VLM agents act as coordinators, planners, perception actors or interfaces that invoke APIs, incl. community ROS packages, with a taxonomy of integration approaches.
- ⚪ [**Survey of VLA Models for Embodied Manipulation (Chinese)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15201 "Survey of Vision-Language-Action Models for Embodied Manipulation") · 2025-08 — Chinese-language VLA survey covering architecture history, model structures, training datasets, pre- and post-training methods, and evaluation.
- 🟡 [**Large VLM-based VLA survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.13073 "Large VLM-based Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation: A Survey") · 2025-08 · Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen) — Splits VLM-based VLAs into monolithic (single- and dual-system) and hierarchical models that decouple planning from execution via interpretable intermediates, and covers RL, human-video and world-model integration. [code](https://github.com/JiuTian-VL/Large-VLM-based-VLA-for-Robotic-Manipulation)
- ⚪ [**Large Model Empowered Embodied AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10399 "Large Model Empowered Embodied AI: A Survey on Decision-Making and Embodied Learning") · 2025-08 — Surveys hierarchical (planning, execution, feedback) and end-to-end VLA decision-making, how large models enhance imitation learning and RL, and the role of world models in embodied decision-making and learning.
- 🟡 [**VLA survey (action tokenization)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01925 "A Survey on Vision-Language-Action Models: An Action Tokenization Perspective") · 2025-07 · Peking University / PsiBot — Unifies VLAs as chains of action tokens and categorizes them as language, code, affordance, trajectory, goal state, latent, raw action or reasoning, analyzing strengths and limits of each type. [code](https://github.com/Psi-Robot/Awesome-VLA-Papers)
- ⚪ [**VLA Models in Robotic Manipulation (systematic review)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.10672 "Vision Language Action Models in Robotic Manipulation: A Systematic Review") · 2025-07 — Systematic review of 102 VLA models, 26 datasets and 12 simulation platforms for manipulation, with a dataset comparison criterion based on task complexity, modalities and scale.
- ⚪ [**Sporks of AGI**](https://sergeylevine.substack.com/p/sporks-of-agi) · 2025-07 · Sergey Levine (essay) — Essay arguing that surrogate data (simulation, human video, hand-held grippers) cannot replace real robot experience for robotic foundation models and should complement it rather than substitute for it.
- ⚪ [**Physical Simulators and World Models (survey)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00917 "A Survey: Learning Embodied Intelligence from Physical Simulators and World Models") · 2025-07 — Survey of how physical simulators and learned world models complement each other for training and evaluating embodied agents.
- ⚪ [**Embodied AI Agents: Modeling the World**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22355) · 2025-06 · Meta — Meta paper proposing that world models of the physical world and of users' mental states are central to embodied agents (avatars, wearables, robots), integrating perception, planning, memory and control.
- 🟡 [**VLA Models: Concepts, Progress, Applications and Challenges**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.04769 "Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models: Concepts, Progress, Applications and Challenges") · 2025-05 · Cornell University et al. — Review of 80+ VLA models from the past three years covering architectures, efficient training, real-time inference and applications (driving, medical, agriculture, humanoids, AR), with proposed agentic directions. [code](https://github.com/Applied-AI-Research-Lab/Vision-Language-Action-Models-Concepts-Progress-Applications-and-Challenges)
- ⚪ [**Neural Brain**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07634 "Neural Brain: A Neuroscience-inspired Framework for Embodied Agents") · 2025-05 — Neuroscience-inspired framework and review for an embodied agent 'brain' integrating active multimodal sensing, perception-cognition-action, plasticity-based memory, and neuromorphic hardware/software.
- ⚪ [**Embodied AI with FMs for Mobile Service Robots**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20503 "Embodied AI with Foundation Models for Mobile Service Robots: A Systematic Review") · 2025-05 — Systematic review of LLMs, VLMs, MLLMs and VLAs for mobile service robots, focused on instruction-to-action translation, multimodal perception, uncertainty for safe decisions and onboard compute limits.
- 🟢 [**Embodied-AI-Guide**](https://github.com/TianxingChen/Embodied-AI-Guide) · 2025-03 · Lumina Embodied AI community — Chinese-language, encyclopedia-style guide to embodied AI with a hands-on RoboTwin 2.0 tutorial walking through data, policy training and evaluation.
- ⚪ [**Towards Robust and Secure Embodied AI**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.13175 "Towards Robust and Secure Embodied AI: A Survey on Vulnerabilities and Attacks") · 2025-02 — Classifies embodied-AI vulnerabilities as exogenous or endogenous and reviews adversarial attacks on perception, decision-making and interaction, including jailbreaks of LLM/LVLM planners.
- ⚪ [**LLMs for Multi-Robot Systems (survey)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03814 "Large Language Models for Multi-Robot Systems: A Survey") · 2025-02 — Survey of LLM use in multi-robot systems across task allocation, motion planning, action generation and human intervention, covering domains such as household, construction and formation control, plus open challenges.
- ⚪ [**Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.02116 "Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation: Current Progress and Challenges in Control, Planning, and Learning") · 2025-01 — Covers model-based contact planning and whole-body control, learning-based RL and imitation, foundation models for generalist humanoids, and whole-body tactile sensing for humanoid loco-manipulation.
- 🟢 [**Awesome Embodied VLA / VA / VLN**](https://github.com/jonyzhang2023/awesome-embodied-vla-va-vln) · 2025-01 — Curated collection of 700+ papers on VLA and world-action models, vision-language navigation, vision-action policies, MLLM-based embodied learning, sim-to-real, benchmarks and simulators.

**2024**

- 🟡 [**Understanding World or Predicting Future?**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.14499 "Understanding World or Predicting Future? A Comprehensive Survey of World Models") · 2024-11 · Tsinghua University — Categorizes world models by function, building internal representations of world mechanisms versus predicting future states for decision-making, and reviews their use in games, driving, robotics and social simulation. [code](https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/World-Model)
- 🟢 [**Awesome World Models for Robotics**](https://github.com/leofan90/Awesome-World-Models) · 2024-11 — Curated list of world-model papers for general video generation, embodied AI and autonomous driving.
- 🟢 [**Awesome Humanoid Robot Learning**](https://github.com/YanjieZe/awesome-humanoid-robot-learning) · 2024-10 — Paper list for humanoid robot learning organized by task (loco-manipulation and whole-body control, manipulation, teleoperation, locomotion), preferring works with real-robot experiments and open code.
- 🟡 [**Aligning Cyber Space with Physical World**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.06886 "Aligning Cyber Space with Physical World: A Comprehensive Survey on Embodied AI") · 2024-07 · Sun Yat-sen University — Broad embodied-AI survey of robots and simulators, embodied perception, interaction, agents and sim-to-real adaptation, emphasizing multimodal large models and world models as agent architectures. [code](https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/Embodied_AI_Paper_List)
- 🟡 [**VLA survey (Ma et al.)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14093 "A Survey on Vision-Language-Action Models for Embodied AI") · 2024-05 · CUHK — Early VLA taxonomy spanning VLA components, low-level control policies and high-level task planners that decompose long-horizon tasks for VLAs, plus datasets, simulators and benchmarks. [code](https://github.com/yueen-ma/Awesome-VLA)
- ⚪ [**Neural Scaling Laws in Robotics**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14005) · 2024-05 — Meta-analysis of 327 papers quantifying how data, model size and compute affect robot foundation models and LLMs on robotics tasks, finding power-law improvements.
- 🟡 [**Is Sora a World Simulator?**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.03520 "Is Sora a World Simulator? A Comprehensive Survey on General World Models and Beyond") · 2024-05 — Survey of general world models spanning video generation, autonomous-driving world models and world models inside autonomous agents, with challenges and future directions. [code](https://github.com/GigaAI-research/General-World-Models-Survey)
- ⚪ [**Real-World Robot Applications of FMs**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05741 "Real-World Robot Applications of Foundation Models: A Review") · 2024-02 · University of Tokyo et al. — Reviews practical use of LLMs/VLMs in real robot systems, organized by which existing component (perception, motion planning, control) a model replaces and by its input-output interface.
- ⚪ [**A Survey on Robotics with Foundation Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02385 "A Survey on Robotics with Foundation Models: toward Embodied AI") · 2024-02 — Overview of foundation models in robotics focused on autonomous manipulation, spanning high-level planning and low-level control, and how they help scale robot learning.
- ⚪ [**LLMs for Robotics: Opportunities, Challenges, and Perspectives**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.04334 "Large Language Models for Robotics: Opportunities, Challenges, and Perspectives") · 2024-01 — Overview of LLM and multimodal-LLM integration into robot tasks, plus a GPT-4V framework that combines language instructions with visual perception for embodied task planning.

**2023**

- 🟡 [**General-Purpose Robots via Foundation Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.08782 "Toward General-Purpose Robots via Foundation Models: A Survey and Meta-Analysis") · 2023-12 · CMU et al. — Taxonomy of reusing NLP/CV foundation models in robotics versus building robotics-specific ones, plus a meta-analysis and discussion of the main barriers to generalist robots. [code](https://github.com/JeffreyYH/Awesome-Generalist-Robots-via-Foundation-Models) · [project](https://robotics-fm-survey.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**Foundation Models in Robotics survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07843 "Foundation Models in Robotics: Applications, Challenges, and the Future") · 2023-12 · Stanford et al. — Surveys where pretrained LLMs/VLMs enter the robot autonomy stack (perception, decision-making, control) and flags data scarcity, safety and uncertainty quantification, and real-time execution as open problems. [code](https://github.com/robotics-survey/Awesome-Robotics-Foundation-Models)
- ⚪ [**Bridging Language and Action**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.10807 "Bridging Language and Action: A Survey of Language-Conditioned Robot Manipulation") · 2023-12 — Categorizes how language enters manipulation systems: for state evaluation, as a policy condition, for planning and reasoning, and inside unified vision-language-action models.
- ⚪ [**Robot Learning in the Era of Foundation Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.14379 "Robot Learning in the Era of Foundation Models: A Survey") · 2023-11 — Reviews foundation-model techniques for robot learning (simulators, datasets, frameworks) across manipulation, navigation, planning and reasoning, and flags gaps such as hardware-software decoupling and dynamic data.
- ⚪ [**LLMs for Robotics survey**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.07226 "Large Language Models for Robotics: A Survey") · 2023-11 — Reviews LLM use across robot perception, decision-making, planning, control and human-robot interaction, and outlines challenges for LLM-based embodied intelligence.
- 🟢 [**Awesome Embodied Robotics and Agent**](https://github.com/zchoi/Awesome-Embodied-Robotics-and-Agent) · 2023-07 — Curated list of embodied robotics and agent research built on VLMs and LLMs, covering VLAs, benchmarks and self-evolving agents; maintained since 2023.
- ⚪ [**Generative Simulation (position paper)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.10455 "Towards Generalist Robots: A Promising Paradigm via Generative Simulation") · 2023-05 — Position paper arguing for generative simulation, in which foundation and generative models create tasks, scenes and training supervision at scale, as a path toward generalist robots.
- ⚪ [**Foundation Models for Decision Making**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.04129 "Foundation Models for Decision Making: Problems, Methods, and Opportunities") · 2023-03 · Google / UC Berkeley — Frames how foundation models enter sequential decision making (prompting, generative modeling, planning, optimal control, RL) across dialogue, driving and robotics, and lists open problems for acting agents.

**2022**

- 🟢 [**Awesome-LLM-Robotics**](https://github.com/GT-RIPL/Awesome-LLM-Robotics) · 2022-08 · Georgia Tech (RIPL) — Long-running curated list of papers using LLMs and multimodal models for robotics and RL, organized by reasoning, planning, manipulation, navigation, simulation and safety.

**2021**

- ⚪ [**A Survey of Embodied AI: From Simulators to Research Tasks**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.04918) · 2021-03 — Pre-foundation-model survey that evaluates nine embodied-AI simulators on seven features and reviews visual exploration, visual navigation and embodied question answering.
